review_comment: In another class, there's a comment that the exception is intentionally excluded - I think we should copy that here.

If `features` can be `null` you'll want to wrap this in a null check similar to [`writeOptionalStringCollection`](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/944b3f3b56caf910ab1730afe1114bd154e59ec6/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/common/io/stream/StreamOutput.java#L1244-L1251), otherwise this will explode when `writeList` tries to call `.size()` on the null object.

I'm not sure why we don't have a `writeOptionalList` on `StreamOutput` already. Possibly to encourage using empty lists instead of `null`?

I think the best solution might be to make `features` non-nullable - either throw in the constructor when it's null, or do what's done today in `getFeatures()` and just replace the null with an empty list.
I'll convert null to an empty list in the constructor.
Why do we deeply check the features list in the Get Response tests, but only check the size here?
Ah, because this one is unfinished. I'll get it set up.
